responses.value: Move customers to direct booking with a 5% discount. Commissions to online travel sites rose from 10% to 22% of revenue, while revenue, fuel and driver costs were flat, so commissions explain the drop. 70% of customers say they'd book directly for 5% off; moving $5.6M of bookings from a 22% commission to a 5% discount saves about $950,000 a year. The main risk is that the sites rank us lower. The next step is to launch direct booking and track how many bookings move.
Hold. 70% would book direct for 5% off, saving about $952,000 a year. Launch direct booking.
